latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor in Hindi — edit videos with Hindi captions via chat.

- Instantly edit and caption Hindi-language videos just by describing what you want—no timeline or manual settings.
- Automatic backend connection with support for free, anonymous 7-day tokens and session management.
- Upload raw smartphone footage, receive 1080p MP4s with added Hindi subtitles and captions within minutes.
- Supports video uploads, export, track preview, Hindi captioning, and session state management.
- Error handling for token expiries, missing credits, unsupported files, and account/plan issues.
- Designed for workflows including quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinements.
